items.html: And indeed, all this aspect that was in all the worlds, all was for the benefit of the worlds, to connect this one with that one, and that one with this one, so that they might be able to receive illumination, each from the other, through the fact that the end of Atzilut is the very beginning of the head of Beriah, and likewise in the rest of the worlds. And this is the secret of the day of Shabbat, for then additional holiness is added to the worlds, and then the upper palace, the Holy of Holies of Beriah, returns to ascend into Atzilut and becomes literally complete Atzilut, for the above-mentioned reason. And likewise in the rest of the worlds, and there is no need to elaborate.
